column1: # UnicodeFontSet font policy. TAB-separated, one font per row.
#   system-overlay    replaces a stock font; preserves its cmap by default unless remove is configured.
#   normal-fallback   processed in this exact order; deduplicated against system + earlier retained fallbacks.
#   terminal-fallback processed after all normal fallbacks; deduplicated against all preceding effective coverage.
#   [ff-4e02,1df02,30ede]     ranges and/or single codepoints (hex; U+ prefix also accepted)
#   remove always wins over protect. Range filtering applies to the nominal Unicode cmap;
#   cmap format 14 UVS/IVS records are preserved unchanged.
